data.name: Dash and Smash
data.detailed_description:
The ultimate chaotic party brawler for couch battles and online mayhem!

Grab your friends, pick your fighter, and dive into the madness! Dash and Smash is a fast-paced, chaotic party brawler. Built for late-night couch sessions with friends or fierce online competition. With colorful visuals, wild stage hazards, and distinct character playstyles, no two matches are ever the same.

Key Features

  • Local and Online Multiplayer
    Brawl it out with up to 8 players, whether you're on the couch or connecting from across the globe.

  • Unique Characters, Unique Playstyles
    Choose from a growing roster of fighters, each with their own abilities and strategies to master.

  • Powerful Items
    Grab game-changing items to buff your fighter and turn the tide of battle.

Game Modes

  • Hold the Beer – Secure the sacred drink and keep it safe. Whoever holds it the longest wins.

  • Chaos Mode – Crank up the madness with extra traps, hazards, and total mayhem.

  • Classic – No frills, no mercy. The last one standing claims victory.

  • And more to come!

Built with the Community

We’re building Dash and Smash hand in hand with our community. Follow our development journey, share your feedback, and help shape the future of the game.

Follow us on social media for dev updates, sneak peeks, and more.

data.short_description: Dash and Smash is a chaotic party brawler where players clash in fast-paced, physics-driven battles. Choose unique characters and Dash and Smash your way to victory, locally with friends or online!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (dual-core)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics or equivalent
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (quad-core or better)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 560 or better
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
